sn_aia_version.instructions:
1. Receive the manager's request to generate a Food Management Intelligence report.
2. Collect the required campus food-service data from the application using the available tools.
3. Analyze all relevant food complaints and summarize them by Mess Hall.
4. Analyze complaints by Food Item and identify frequently reported food items.
5. Analyze complaints by Meal Type, including Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner.
6. Analyze complaints by Use Case, including Food Quality Complaint, Food Hygiene Issue, Allergy Management Request, Meal Not Available, Food Wastage Reporting, and other configured use cases.
7. Analyze complaints by Problem Type and Priority.
8. Analyze the number of students affected by the reported food-service problems.
9. Analyze Food Incidents and identify relevant high-risk or critical incidents.
10. Analyze Corrective Actions and CAPA records, including their status and unresolved actions.
11. Analyze available historical data to identify recurring problems and important trends.
12. Combine the retrieved analysis from all relevant data sources.
13. Identify significant patterns, recurring issues, high-risk areas, and areas requiring management attention.
14. Generate clear management-level insights based only on the retrieved application data.
15. Generate practical recommended management actions based only on the available evidence.
16. Prepare a comprehensive Food Management Intelligence report containing an overall summary, detailed analysis, key insights, trends, and recommended actions.
17. Do not invent data, counts, trends, incidents, or recommendations that are not supported by the retrieved application data.
